name: Dr Christine James
title: Psychologist
description: I am a Clinical Psychologist with over 25 years' experience in the public and private sectors. I work with trauma, depresssion and anxiety. I am an accredited EMDR practitioner and am intensively trained in DBT.
specialties: Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Dissociative Identity Disorder, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Sexual abuse, EMDR

name: Rebecca Youl
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Rebecca is a registered Clinical Psychologist. For the past twenty years, she has fulfilled various roles within public welfare and health settings, perinatal services, and in private psychotherapy practice.
specialties: Dissociative Identity Disorder, Sexual abuse, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD)

name: Dr Stan Alexiou
title: Psychologist
description: Stan is a registered clinical psychologist who has completed a Doctorate in Clinical Psychology and is also a member of the Australian Psychological Society (APS). He has 18 years of training and experience in private practice, community counselling, educational settings, and public mental health settings.
specialties: Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Sexual abuse, Dissociative Identity Disorder, EMDR

name: Sarah Axford
title: Psychologist
description: The cornerstone of psychological health is healing. What follows is awareness and transformation of the ways we relate to ourselves, the environment and each other. Particular areas of interest are: Self development, Trauma, Shock, Anxiety, Relationships, Attachment, Addiction, Depression, Stress, Grief, Phobia, Anger, and Shame.
specialties: Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Dissociative Identity Disorder, Sexual abuse, Sexual difficulties, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD)

name: Sara Moshenrose
title: Psychologist
description: I am an AHPRA registered Clinical Psychologist and Accredited EMDR Practitioner with over 13 years of experience. I have a passion for offering experiences of transformative healing and change. I take a person-centered, holistic approach, and I have a special focus in the delivery and application of Eye Movement Desensitisation Reprocessing (EMDR) and Mindfulness-Centred Somatic Psychotherapy (Hakomi). I have current availability for clients interested in one or two-week EMDR Intensive programs: https://mindfulliving.com.au/project/sara-moshenrose-principle-clinician/ Whether you are seeking individual therapy for yourself or are looking for supervision to deepen your practice as a therapist, it would be great to hear from you.
specialties: Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Dissociative Identity Disorder, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Sexual abuse, Sexual difficulties, EMDR

name: Navid Khorassani
title: Psychologist
description: Most people know something in them is stuck. They feel it in the same arguments, the same withdrawals, the same quiet dread. Navid Khorassani is a Clinical Psychologist and psychoanalytic psychotherapist who believes that beneath anxiety, depression, complex trauma, and the turbulence of BPD lies a story worth understanding, not just managing.
specialties: Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Sex worker issues, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Sexual abuse, Dissociative Identity Disorder

name: Dr Michael Thayer
title: Psychologist
description: I work with children and adolescents and their parents with issues such as anxiety, depression, anger management, behavioural issues, trauma related issues, separation issues, Aspergers Syndrome, ADHD, etc. I am able to see clients under the NDIS.
specialties: Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Dissociative Identity Disorder, Sexual abuse

name: Louise Ferraz De Camargo
title: Psychologist
description: My goal as a psychologist is to support adults who have experienced childhood trauma including sexual, emotional, and physical abuse. I am also interested in working with people who feel that their childhood was lacking in some way, for example, by others having high expectations of them or through experiences of bullying. I have a Masters in Clinical Psychology and am a member of the Blue Knot Foundation - Centre of Excellence for Complex Trauma.
specialties: Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Dissociative Identity Disorder, Sexual abuse, Schema Therapy
